meaning_zh: 本表记录主键，用于引用。
meaning_en: Record primary key for references.

meaning_zh: 产能对应时期，引用time_unit.id。
meaning_en: Capacity period referencing time_unit.id.

meaning_zh: 已占用或不可用比例[0,1]；正常可用时间为scale×(1−used)。
meaning_en: Occupied or unavailable fraction [0,1]; normal-period availability is scale×(1−used).

meaning_zh: 产能所属资源，引用workcenter.id。
meaning_en: Resource owning the capacity, referencing workcenter.id.

meaning_zh: 本表记录主键，用于引用。
meaning_en: Record primary key for references.

meaning_zh: 发生物料需求的工序，引用process.id。
meaning_en: Consuming operation referencing process.id.

meaning_zh: 所需物料，引用material.id。
meaning_en: Required material referencing material.id.

unit: 物料单位/产出单位 / material units per output unit
meaning_zh: 工序配套数量；本课按一件工序产出定义，必须与出件率和供给单位一致。
meaning_en: Operation material coefficient; this course uses one unit of operation output, consistent with output and supply units.

meaning_zh: 存在替代料时的配套优先级，由相应策略采用。
meaning_en: Preference among substitute supplies, applied by the relevant selection policy.

meaning_zh: 本表记录主键，用于引用。
meaning_en: Record primary key for references.

meaning_zh: 受限制制品，引用product.id。
meaning_en: Constrained product referencing product.id.

meaning_zh: 限制生效时期，引用time_unit.id。
meaning_en: Period of the bound referencing time_unit.id.

meaning_zh: 同值表示共用库存，单位及容量分配需明确。
meaning_en: Common value denotes shared inventory, with explicit units and allocation.

unit: 累计制品数量 / cumulative product units
meaning_zh: 累计生产入库上限，由期初库存、收支与库容推导；NULL为未配置。
meaning_en: Cumulative production-receipt ceiling derived from opening stock, flows, and capacity; null means unspecified.

meaning_zh: 紧迫性或周转相关值，采用方式由业务策略说明。
meaning_en: Urgency or turnover-related value interpreted by the business policy.

unit: 累计制品数量 / cumulative product units
meaning_zh: 累计生产入库下限，由安全库存等要求推导；NULL为未配置。
meaning_en: Cumulative production-receipt floor derived from safety-stock or similar requirements; null means unspecified.

meaning_zh: 本表记录主键，用于引用。
meaning_en: Record primary key for references.

meaning_zh: 物料可用时点，引用time_unit.id。
meaning_en: Availability period referencing time_unit.id.

meaning_zh: 已就绪物料，引用material.id。
meaning_en: Ready material referencing material.id.

meaning_zh: 就绪或可用数量；当前累计输入示例采用首期可用量及后续增量，不混入累计快照。
meaning_en: Ready quantity; the cumulative-input exercise uses opening availability and later increments, not repeated cumulative snapshots.

meaning_zh: 本表记录主键，用于引用。
meaning_en: Record primary key for references.

meaning_zh: 物料业务编码。
meaning_en: Business material code.

meaning_zh: 物料名称。
meaning_en: Material name.

unit: 编码或文本 / code or text
meaning_zh: 供应商信息。
meaning_en: Supplier information.

meaning_zh: 可替换物料采用同一值；无替代关系为NULL。
meaning_en: Common value identifies substitutes; null indicates no substitute group.

meaning_zh: 物料依赖或配套选型关系，需有对应解释与策略。
meaning_en: Material dependency or coordinated selection relationship, with a defined interpretation and policy.

meaning_zh: 预留扩展字段，例如供应商优先级；当前为整数，使用前定义含义和取值规则。
meaning_en: Reserved extension, for example supplier priority; currently an integer, with meaning and allowed values defined before use.

meaning_zh: 本表记录主键，用于引用。
meaning_en: Record primary key for references.

meaning_zh: 订单描述。
meaning_en: Order description.

meaning_zh: 订单头优先级，排序方向由采用策略说明。
meaning_en: Order-header priority; the adopting policy defines its ordering direction.

meaning_zh: 订单业务编码。
meaning_en: Business order code.

meaning_zh: 订单创建时间；保留原始时间，不映射为计划时间单元。
meaning_en: Order creation timestamp, retained rather than mapped to a planning time unit.

meaning_zh: 本表记录主键，用于引用。
meaning_en: Record primary key for references.

meaning_zh: 需求制品，引用product.id；设计中的production_id按制品语义对应此字段。
meaning_en: Demanded product referencing product.id; the design name production_id denotes this product reference.

meaning_zh: 所属订单头，引用order_info.id，对应order_information_id。
meaning_en: Parent order referencing order_info.id; corresponds to order_information_id.

meaning_zh: 交付时间单元，引用time_unit.id；有交期需求应给出有效引用。
meaning_en: Due-period reference to time_unit.id; a dated requirement needs a valid reference.

meaning_zh: 该条交付需求数量；分期需求分别记录，避免重复录入累计值。
meaning_en: Quantity for this delivery requirement; record period requirements without duplicating cumulative totals.

meaning_zh: 本表记录主键，用于引用。
meaning_en: Record primary key for references.

meaning_zh: 执行计划任务的workcenter.id。
meaning_en: workcenter.id executing the planned work.

meaning_zh: 任务执行时期，引用time_unit.id。
meaning_en: Execution period referencing time_unit.id.

meaning_zh: 执行的工序，引用process.id；特定空序列槽位可用NULL。
meaning_en: Executed operation referencing process.id; a documented empty sequence slot may use null.

unit: 工序产出数量 / operation-output units
meaning_zh: 计划产出，不是加工次数；多工序合计不等于成品交付。
meaning_en: Planned output, not cycle count; sums across operations are not finished deliveries.

meaning_zh: 扩展字段；循环排程可约定为循环序号。
meaning_en: Extension field; a circular schedule may define a cycle number.

meaning_zh: 扩展字段；循环排程可约定为序列位置。
meaning_en: Extension field; a circular schedule may define a sequence position.

meaning_zh: 预留扩展字段，使用前定义含义。
meaning_en: Reserved extension field; define its meaning before use.

meaning_zh: 本表记录主键，用于引用。
meaning_en: Record primary key for references.

meaning_zh: 所属工艺路线，引用process_route.id。
meaning_en: Owning route referencing process_route.id.

meaning_zh: 工序名称。
meaning_en: Operation name.

meaning_zh: 工序业务编码。
meaning_en: Business operation code.

meaning_zh: 路线内工序编号；与执行顺序分开，按路线检查唯一性。
meaning_en: Operation number within a route; separate from execution order and checked for route-level uniqueness.

meaning_zh: 工序顺序数；相同值表示无先后依赖，实际并行仍取决于其他条件。
meaning_en: Precedence value; equal values mean no precedence, while concurrency depends on other conditions.

meaning_zh: 本表记录主键，用于引用。
meaning_en: Record primary key for references.

meaning_zh: 被适配工序，引用process.id。
meaning_en: Mapped operation referencing process.id.

meaning_zh: 可执行该工序的资源，引用workcenter.id。
meaning_en: Compatible execution resource referencing workcenter.id.

meaning_zh: 该工序选用此资源的优先级。
meaning_en: Priority of this resource option for the operation.

unit: 约定数量单位 / declared quantity unit
meaning_zh: 在制品缓存容量；0的具体模型含义及约束采用方式需核对。
meaning_en: WIP buffer capacity; check the model meaning of zero and how the limit is applied.

meaning_zh: 当前离散模板为单次加工产出；连续生产设计需明确单位时间产出的转换。
meaning_en: Per-cycle output in the current discrete template; a continuous interpretation requires an explicit rate conversion.

meaning_zh: 标准单次加工时长，来源节拍应转换为这一口径。
meaning_en: Standard duration per cycle; convert source cycle or rate data to this basis.

meaning_zh: 工艺切换时长；是否包含首次准备须在场景中说明。
meaning_en: Operation changeover time; specify whether initial setup is included.

meaning_zh: 按批加工数量，应为单次出件数量的整数倍。
meaning_en: Batch quantity, an integer multiple of per-cycle output.

meaning_zh: 设备综合效率；当前默认100，实际折减位置由配置说明。
meaning_en: Overall equipment effectiveness; current default 100, with the loss-accounting layer specified by configuration.

meaning_zh: 同值表示共同加工；NULL或单独组不形成多工序共同加工。
meaning_en: Equal values join jointly processed operations; null or a singleton does not form a multi-operation group.

meaning_zh: 本表记录主键，用于引用。
meaning_en: Record primary key for references.

meaning_zh: 路线所属制品，引用product.id；一制品可有多路线。
meaning_en: Route owner referencing product.id; one product can have multiple routes.

meaning_zh: 工艺路线名称。
meaning_en: Route name.

meaning_zh: 工艺路线业务编码。
meaning_en: Business route code.

meaning_zh: 路线选择优先级，须由路线策略解释。
meaning_en: Route-selection priority interpreted by the routing policy.

meaning_zh: 加工路线的业务说明。
meaning_en: Business description of the route.

meaning_zh: 本表记录主键，用于引用。
meaning_en: Record primary key for references.

meaning_zh: 制品名称，可为成品、半成品或零部件。
meaning_en: Name of a finished item, intermediate item, or component.

meaning_zh: 制品业务编码，与记录id分别管理。
meaning_en: Business product code, managed separately from record id.

meaning_zh: 所属成品唯一编码；不单独定义装配数量。
meaning_en: Unique code of the finished item to which the product belongs; it does not define assembly quantities by itself.

meaning_zh: 引用property_1.id；本场景应固定说明其业务维度。
meaning_en: References property_1.id; declare its business dimension for the scenario.

meaning_zh: 引用property_2.id；与第一属性构成独立分类维度。
meaning_en: References property_2.id as another classification dimension.

meaning_zh: 引用property_3.id；空值表示未关联此维度。
meaning_en: References property_3.id; null means no associated value in this dimension.

meaning_zh: 本表记录主键，用于引用。
meaning_en: Record primary key for references.

meaning_zh: 属性名称，如型号、配置、颜色；与具体编码及属性值配合解释。
meaning_en: Attribute name, such as model, configuration or color; interpreted with its code and value.

meaning_zh: 属性编码；在场景内保持稳定分类与映射。
meaning_en: Attribute code with stable classification and mapping within the scenario.

meaning_zh: 属性数值；当前SQLite类型为FLOAT，文字标签保存在名称和编码。
meaning_en: Numeric attribute value; the current SQLite type is FLOAT, with text labels in name and code.

meaning_zh: 关键属性标识，表达需求中区分制品的必要属性；当前加载器据此选取属性字段。
meaning_en: Marks an attribute needed to distinguish demanded products; the current loader uses it to select attribute fields.

meaning_zh: 本表记录主键，用于引用。
meaning_en: Record primary key for references.

meaning_zh: 属性名称，如型号、配置、颜色；与具体编码及属性值配合解释。
meaning_en: Attribute name, such as model, configuration or color; interpreted with its code and value.

meaning_en: Attribute code with stable classification and mapping within the scenario.

meaning_en: Numeric attribute value; the current SQLite type is FLOAT, with text labels in name and code.

meaning_zh: 关键属性标识，表达需求中区分制品的必要属性；当前加载器据此选取属性字段。
meaning_en: Marks an attribute needed to distinguish demanded products; the current loader uses it to select attribute fields.

meaning_zh: 本表记录主键，用于引用。
meaning_en: Record primary key for references.

meaning_zh: 属性名称，如型号、配置、颜色；与具体编码及属性值配合解释。
meaning_en: Attribute name, such as model, configuration or color; interpreted with its code and value.

meaning_zh: 属性编码；在场景内保持稳定分类与映射。
meaning_en: Attribute code with stable classification and mapping within the scenario.

meaning_zh: 属性数值；当前SQLite类型为FLOAT，文字标签保存在名称和编码。
meaning_en: Numeric attribute value; the current SQLite type is FLOAT, with text labels in name and code.

meaning_zh: 关键属性标识，表达需求中区分制品的必要属性；当前加载器据此选取属性字段。
meaning_en: Marks an attribute needed to distinguish demanded products; the current loader uses it to select attribute fields.

meaning_zh: 本表记录主键，用于引用。
meaning_en: Record primary key for references.

meaning_zh: 作为共享资源的workcenter.id。
meaning_en: workcenter.id representing the shared resource itself.

meaning_zh: 依赖该资源的目标workcenter.id。
meaning_en: Target workcenter.id depending on the resource.

meaning_zh: 本表记录主键，用于引用。
meaning_en: Record primary key for references.

meaning_zh: 相对计划起点的顺序偏移；与主键分开。
meaning_en: Sequence offset from the planning origin; distinct from the primary key.

meaning_zh: 时间单元长度，小时级为3600，八小时窗口为28800。
meaning_en: Period length: 3600 for an hour, 28800 for an eight-hour window.

meaning_zh: 1正常、0不可用、-1特殊或可选；可选状态需明确采用方式。
meaning_en: 1 normal, 0 unavailable, -1 special or optional; specify how optional time is adopted.

meaning_zh: 本表记录主键，用于引用。
meaning_en: Record primary key for references.

meaning_zh: 工作中心名称，如设备、班组、区域、外协或组织。
meaning_en: Work-center name, such as a machine, team, area, subcontractor, or organization.

meaning_zh: 资源业务编码。
meaning_en: Business resource code.

meaning_zh: 叶子节点为0，非叶子节点非0。
meaning_en: 0 for a leaf node; nonzero for a non-leaf.

meaning_zh: 并行能力数量；与工位数分别建模。
meaning_en: Number of parallel units, modeled separately from station count.

meaning_zh: 工位数量，结合热处理、循环产线等具体结构解释。
meaning_en: Station count, interpreted for the actual structure such as a furnace or circular line.

meaning_zh: 工作中心配置准备时间；本课程按秒，与工序切换时间分别核算。
meaning_en: Work-center preparation duration; seconds in this course, accounted separately from operation changeovers.

meaning_zh: 父工作中心，引用workcenter.id；根节点为空。
meaning_en: Parent workcenter.id; null for a root.
